description: This file contains unit tests for the 'compatibility' package in Kubernetes, focusing on version registry, feature gates, version mapping, and metrics.

methods.name: TestEffectiveVersionRegistry
methods.description: Tests registration and overriding of component effective versions.

methods.name: testRegistry
methods.description: Sets up a test registry with predefined component versions and feature gates.

methods.name: TestVersionFlagOptions
methods.description: Verifies version flag options for components.

methods.name: TestVersionFlagOptionsWithMapping
methods.description: Tests version flag options after applying version mappings.

methods.name: TestVersionedFeatureGateFlags
methods.description: Checks the correctness of feature gate flags based on registry state.

methods.name: TestFlags
methods.description: Comprehensive testing of command-line flag parsing and validation for component versions and feature gates.

methods.name: TestVersionMapping
methods.description: Tests setting and overriding version mappings between components.

methods.name: TestVersionMappingWithMultipleDependency
methods.description: Tests multiple dependencies in version mappings.

methods.name: TestVersionMappingWithCyclicDependency
methods.description: Ensures cyclic version mappings are detected and produce errors.

methods.name: TestAddMetrics
methods.description: Verifies metrics registration and output for component versions.

methods.name: assertVersionEqualTo
methods.description: Helper to assert version equality in tests.

methods.name: Test_enabledAlphaFeatures
methods.description: Tests filtering of enabled alpha features based on feature gate settings.
